content.subject: Quick note on reconciliation workload
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
ShipMonk reported $225M ARR and $300M raised. Such capital influx significant expands intercompany reconciliation workloads. Teams handling that growth spend regular weeks reconciling data each month.
We build bots that match and post intercompany journal entries, reducing manual effort and error risk.
If you have 15 minutes next week, I can walk through a clear demo session.
Zamp
